description: All stations of the national NABEL air pollution monitoring network with type, altitude, coordinates and a link to each station's live hourly data on the BAFU site (measurement values themselves are not returned). Optionally sorted by distance from a point (pass both near_lat and near_lon).

near_lat.description: Optional WGS84 latitude to sort by distance

name: list_air_quality_stations
